The latest update has made this app completely useless for me. For years, whenever I selected a category in the spending chart, it showed what percentage of my total spending that category represented during the selected period. That metric was essential to me every single month. Now it has been replaced with the percentage change compared to the previous period. That information is completely useless to me, and removing the metric I've relied on for years makes the app lose all of its value.
